items.title: CISA Warns of Palo Alto PAN-OS Vulnerability Exploited to Gain Root Access
items.description: CISA has issued an urgent warning regarding a critical vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS. Tracked as CVE-2026-0300, this severe security flaw was recently added to CISA’s Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on May 6, 2026. items.title: ZDI-CAN-29243: DeepSpeed
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Bongeun Koo (@kiddo_pwn)' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-05-07, 0 days ago.
